_doc: Wizard C — weight calibration from logged outcomes (docs/design/wizard-c-calibration.md). Every number the wizard uses lives here; wizards/wizard_c_calibration.py carries none of its own. Buckets are the taxonomy_base revenue bucket names.

confidence._doc: Tier by standardised effect |d| (difference in mean KPI score before positive vs negative outcomes, over the pooled sd). A tier also needs n_pos and n_neg >= min_samples_per_side; below that the tier is 'none' whatever the effect.
